title: Extension of an individual source cotangent functional
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k and c:B -> Spec k morphisms of schemes, U an open of Y, z a point of U, K=kappa_U(z), T a scheme, h:T -> Spec K and g:T -> B times_k Y, with g followed by the source projection equal to h followed by the residue-field point of U and its open immersion. Put A=Gamma(T,O_T), with scalar map alpha:K -> A induced by h. For every K-linear functional l:bertiniCotangentFibre(f,U,z) -> K there is an A-linear functional L:Gamma(T,g^*Omega_(B times_k Y / B)) -> A. For every open W of Y containing U.ι(z), every a in Gamma(Y,W), and every proof that g maps T into the inverse image of W, L sends the restriction of g^*(d(pr_Y^*a)) to alpha(l of the differential component of bertiniLocalFirstJet(f,U,z,W,a)). No smoothness, finite-dimensionality, tensor comparison map or injectivity hypothesis is assumed. [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets].

proof.text: Contract the cotangent-fibre functional with 1 tensor m, obtaining a linear functional on the relative differential stalk on U. Its value on a differential germ is exactly the differential component of bertiniLocalFirstJet.

Construct a morphism from this differential sheaf to the pushforward of O_T along h followed by the residue-field point. On an open containing z, evaluate the germ with the stalk functional, apply the scalar map K to Gamma(T,O_T), and restrict. On an open missing z use zero: its inverse image is empty. Evaluation of residue-field point maps on local sections proves scalar linearity, and the germ restriction identity proves naturality.

Use the universal differential map for U to Y and compose pushforwards to obtain Omega_(Y/k) to (g followed by the source projection)_* O_T. Apply the section-normalized tensor-pullback adjunction along the source projection of Y times_k B, and precompose with the inverse of the normalized relative differential base-change isomorphism. This gives a morphism from Omega_(Y times_k B / B) to the appropriate pushforward of O_T.

Transport this morphism from Y times_k B to B times_k Y using pullback symmetry and the universal differential pushforward map. Apply the normalized tensor-pullback adjunction along g and take its component on the top open. Naturality with respect to open restrictions, the normalized adjunction unit, the base-change formula on da, and h_alpha give the required equality. All constructions include empty inverse images and use no basis or nonempty-scheme hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_source_fibre_differential_functional
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y B T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (c : B ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (U : Y.Opens) (z : U)
    (h : T ⟶ Spec ((U : Scheme).residueField z)) (g : T ⟶ pullback c f)
    (hg : g ≫ pullback.snd c f = h ≫ (U : Scheme).fromSpecResidueField z ≫ U.ι)
    (α : (U : Scheme).residueField z →+* Γ(T, ⊤))
    (hα : α = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso ((U : Scheme).residueField z)).inv ≫ h.appTop).hom)
    (l : bertiniCotangentFibre f U z →ₗ[(U : Scheme).residueField z]
      (U : Scheme).residueField z) :
    ∃ L : Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj
        (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials, ⊤) →ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] Γ(T, ⊤),
      ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (hz : U.ι z ∈ W)
        (hV : (⊤ : T.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (a : Γ(Y, W)),
        L (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj
            (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g (pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentials
                ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W)
                ((pullback.fst c f).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d
                  (X := Opposite.op ((pullback.snd c f) ⁻¹ᵁ W))
                  ((pullback.snd c f).app W a)))) =
          α (l (bertiniLocalFirstJet f U z W hz a).2)
